interpretation: SSRD is total horizontal energy; FDIR is direct horizontal energy, not direct normal irradiance

basis.evidence: The supported-variable table identifies the one-hour total field as SSRD/GHI and the direct field as FDIR, both in J/m2 on the gridded collection.
The FDIR parameter definition uses a horizontal receiving plane; accumulated energy is converted to mean flux using its actual duration.
Chapter2 Table2.6 distinguishes horizontal FDIR from the separate direct-normal diagnostic DSRP. WeatherNext's explicit one-hour interval controls accumulation handling.
